investigation.context: NFA-reported investigation following norovirus-associated gastroenteritis cases among children in Tbilisi kindergartens

source.title: No violations found in 129 food samples taken from kindergartens

interpretation_limits: The 694 count is a combined food-and-drinking-water sample count; the source does not provide a water-only count.
The 129 samples reported as compliant are food samples only and must not be presented as water sample results.
The source does not establish that drinking water caused the norovirus-associated gastroenteritis cases.
The water sample results and the remaining investigation results were reported as pending at the publication date.
No kindergarten names, child-level data, personal data or exact addresses are included in this public metadata.
